notes.title: The Food Run - Version 2.3.3 Released
notes.notes:
A minor update with a couple of changes:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved gamepad support.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue on level editor where levels could be flagged as unsaved even when no changes were made.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.3.2 Released
notes.notes:
Updates in this version:

[list]
[*]Minor graphical fixes to prevent some in-game tiles being shown at an angle.
[*]Improved detection of unsaved changes in the level editor.
[*]DLC now loads in the background, speeding things up a bit.
[/list]

notes.title: The Food Run - Level Editor Released!
notes.notes: Anyone think they can come up with some more challenging puzzles for The Food Run? Be our guest! The game now has a level editor that integrates with the Steam Workshop. You can use all the in-game items to create your own levels, and the editor will even solve them for you. Feel free to have a go and share your creations. We'd love to play them.

notes.title: Extra 64 Levels DLC Released
notes.notes:
Hungry for more? We've released an additional 64 levels of The Food Run as DLC with new puzzles, new food, new graphical themes and new music!

With the same level mechanics and star ratings as the main game, these levels are more of a challenge with some requiring up to the maximum 30 moves to complete.

The DLC is available now for just a dollar, and even launches with a 25% discount.

So what are you waiting for? It's time for dessert!

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.notes: Great news for the trading card collectors amongst you - The Food Run now has trading cards enabled. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update - Version 2.1.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
We've made a few improvements and fixes - here's what you can expect...

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
* Added support for touch screens - if you touch the screen during gameplay, controls will appear as buttons on-screen. Simply press a mouse button, joystick button or keyboard key to remove them.
* Displays the "best" stars achieved on each level in the game status area.
* Improved the title screen background - added an image of the character and some falling food.
* Allows the user to cancel redefining a joystick by holding down a button, rather than pressing a keyboard key (otherwise it's technically not full controller support!).

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
* Prevented buttons in the background being clickable while redefining keys.
* Fixed some minor character animation bugs when wrapping around the edges of the screen.
* Fixed issues where buttons could be clicked multiple times on the level select.

The screenshots and trailer video have also been updated.

The game is also now available on [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-GB/store/apps/9nblggh4p2q8?rtc=1]Windows Store[/url] for PC/Windows Mobile.

Thanks for the continued support for the game. Enjoy!
